subject: storytime
title: The Crayons Quit words
about: Duncan opens his crayon box and finds a pile of letters, one from each color, explaining why it is fed up with the way he uses it. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, using a different voice for each crayon.

book.author: Drew Daywalt
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A box of crayons with a lot to say, and a boy who finds a way to make them all happy.

passage.text:
Duncan crayons box letter
quit red purple white
green orange blue peach
color lines sun whale
mad rest

cards.note: capital D, it is his name; two parts: Dun-can; the a says uh: Dun-kun
c-r blend; ay says long a; the o says u; the s says z: kray-unz
tt is one t; two parts: let-ter; er says er
ur says er; le says ul: per-pul
wh says w; magic e makes i say its name
g-r blend; ee says long e
or says or; the a says i and ge says j: or-inj
b-l blend; ue says oo, like in glue
ea says long e; ch is one part
the o says u and or says er: kul-er
magic e makes i say its name; the s says z
wh says w; magic e makes a say its name
all regular; s-t at the end
